findings.criterion: Delegated to child 7b22: the qualified/unqualified decision is made against the REGISTERED PROVIDER SET rather than by prefix shape, so a future provider name needs no second edit here
findings.detail: The codebase still uses `_PROVIDER_QUALIFIER_RE = re.compile(r'^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$')` (a shape/pattern test) in `src/rebar/llm/config.py:192`. The `KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES` frozenset that child 7b22 was supposed to introduce does not exist anywhere in the codebase. `split_provider_qualifier` still tests prefix shape, not registry membership.

citations.description: _resolve_target validates qualifier vs configured provider but does not validate configured provider against a known-provider registry
No test for bedrok typo diagnostic or KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES membership

findings.criterion: Delegated to child 7b22: a provider name that is not registered produces a diagnostic naming the invalid provider and listing the valid ones
findings.detail: Because `KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES` does not exist and `_resolve_target` does not validate the explicitly configured provider against a registry, a typo'd provider (e.g. `_resolve_target('claude-opus-4-8', 'bedrok')`) still passes silently through config resolution, returning `'bedrok:claude-opus-4-8'` without raising `LLMConfigError`. No test for this diagnostic exists in `tests/unit/test_provider_qualifier.py` (no `bedrok` test case found).

citations.description: No back-compat enumeration over 24 provider names, no drift/importorskip test

findings.criterion: Delegated to child 7b22: back-compat is enumerated and tested against the runtime registries, since a stricter test risks breaking provider names that work today but are absent from a static list
findings.detail: No parametrized back-compat test covering all known provider names against runtime registries exists in `tests/unit/test_provider_qualifier.py`. The `KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES` frozenset and the associated drift/subset test (guarded by `pytest.importorskip('pydantic_ai')`) that 7b22 was supposed to add are absent from the codebase.
